newsitem.title: BELGIUM: At least 50,000 Belgians victim of pyramid schemes.
newsitem.headline: At least 50,000 Belgians victim of pyramid schemes.

text.p: At least 50,000 Belgians have fallen prey to fraudulent high-yield "pyramid" investment schemes in the past two years and lost more than six billion francs ($160 million), court officials said on Wednesday.
"The numbers are very realistic but could rise further," a spokesman for the public prosecutor's office in the northern town of Dendermonde told Reuters.
Dozens of people are under investigation or facing charges over fraudulent pyramid schemes, the spokesman said.
Dendermonde was the first prosecutor's office in Belgium to investigate pyramid schemes and is handling most of Belgium's current cases.
But the spokesman was unable to say how many people would be prosecuted.
"It might be 200, perhaps 2,000...the leaders will certainly be prosecuted but there are also a number of people who made a profit to some extent," he said.
He said people often invested money they failed to declare to tax authorities and were reluctant to press charges against the organisers of the pyramid schemes.
"Some have lodged a complaint but the majority still believe they had better keep quiet...there are always people playing with undeclared money," the spokesman said.
